input.prompt: Animate the first frame exactly: same framing, composition, lighting, setting and character. Wushu duilian finale, a rehearsed partner set: the orange copy on the left facing right, the violet copy (two space buns) on the right facing left, coiled in guard. Behind them, small and soft-focus, the same four background figures keep sparring; nobody else appears. Low side-on camera at waist height, holding still, water flying. Every strike is controlled and stops just short; nothing lands and nobody is hurt; they are partners showing a rehearsed set. The two partners are always two separate people with two arms and two legs each; bodies never merge or pass through each other. Exactly six copies stay in frame the whole shot. Their mouths stay closed; nobody sings or speaks. Every copy keeps the same face and outfit as in the first frame, only the band colours differ. One continuous shot, no cuts. No captions, no text.
